title: The Watch I Didn't Buy

pre.en: Who bought the last watch in the shop?
pre.zh: 店里最后一块表是谁买走的？
options: Someone who works in the shop

intro: 小陈看上了一块 240 英镑的手表，网上便宜，店里能试戴，他就这样来回犹豫了两个星期。读的时候留意「the + 比较级, the + 比较级」：The longer I looked at it, the more I wanted it.——越…越…，一句话说出两件事怎么一起变化。

sentences.en: So, for most of October, I wanted one thing.
sentences.zh: 十月的大半个月里，我心里只惦记一样东西。

sentences.en: It was a £240 watch with a plain white face and a dark green leather band.
sentences.zh: 一块 240 英镑的手表，白色素表盘，墨绿色皮表带。

sentences.en: At first, I thought it was a bit boring, but it grew on me.
sentences.zh: 一开始我觉得它有点单调，可越看越顺眼。

sentences.en: The longer I looked at it, the more I wanted it.
sentences.zh: 我看得越久，就越想要。

sentences.en: Online, it was £25 cheaper.
sentences.zh: 网上卖得便宜 25 英镑。

sentences.en: But the shop on Regent Street let me try it on and take my time.
sentences.zh: 可摄政街那家店让我随便试戴，慢慢挑。

sentences.en: And the assistant never once looked at her phone.
sentences.zh: 店员一次都没低头看过手机。

sentences.en: For £240, I wanted to be sure I'd get my money's worth.
sentences.zh: 花 240 英镑，我得确保这钱花得值。

sentences.en: So for two weeks, I went back and forth.
sentences.zh: 于是整整两个星期，我一直拿不定主意。

sentences.en: I added the watch to my online basket three times.
sentences.zh: 我三次把这块表加进了网上的购物车。

sentences.en: The closer I got to paying, the more nervous I felt.
sentences.zh: 离付款越近，我就越紧张。

sentences.en: Each time, I filled in the delivery form.
sentences.zh: 每次我都把收货信息填好了。

sentences.en: Then I had second thoughts.
sentences.zh: 然后又犹豫了。

sentences.en: And I closed the page before I checked out.
sentences.zh: 没结账就把页面关了。

sentences.en: Once, I even changed my mind at the bus stop.
sentences.zh: 有一次在公交站，我又改了主意。

sentences.en: And the more reviews I read, the less sure I was.
sentences.zh: 评价看得越多，我心里越没底。

sentences.en: A few reviewers loved the band.
sentences.zh: 有几个人很喜欢那条表带。

sentences.en: But lots of others said it smelled of plastic.
sentences.zh: 可也有好多人说它一股塑料味。

sentences.en: They couldn't even agree on the colour.
sentences.zh: 他们连颜色都说不到一块儿去。

sentences.en: When Tom asked why I kept walking past the shop, I just said, "It's a long story."
sentences.zh: Tom 问我为什么老在那家店门口转悠，我只说了句：「说来话长。」

sentences.en: Priya tried to point me in the right direction.
sentences.zh: Priya 想给我指条明路。

sentences.en: "Just buy it," she said.
sentences.zh: 「买就是了，」她说。

sentences.en: "The sooner you decide, the better."
sentences.zh: 「越早决定越好。」

sentences.en: I even started an email to the shop: "I'm writing to ask if the green band is still in stock."
sentences.zh: 我甚至给店里写了半封邮件：「我写信是想问一下，绿表带那款还有没有货。」

sentences.en: On the third Saturday, I finally walked in with my card in my hand.
sentences.zh: 第三个周六，我终于攥着银行卡走进了店里。

sentences.en: "I'm afraid it's sold out," the assistant said.
sentences.zh: 「不好意思，已经卖完了，」店员说。

sentences.en: "The last one went yesterday — to a young man with a chef's tattoo."
sentences.zh: 「最后一块昨天卖掉了，买的是个小伙子，胳膊上有个厨师的文身。」

sentences.en: That evening, Tom handed me a small box.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，Tom 递给我一个小盒子。

sentences.en: "Happy birthday," he said.
sentences.zh: 「生日快乐，」他说。

sentences.en: "You wouldn't stop talking about it."
sentences.zh: 「谁让你天天念叨它。」

cards.note: 说衣服、食物也常用：a plain T-shirt、plain rice。
band 常见的意思是「乐队」，这里是一圈带子；表带也叫 watch strap。
if something grows on you, you start to like it more and more
cards.tip: 主语是东西，宾语是人；常和 at first 搭配：一开始不怎么样，后来越看越喜欢。
cards.example: I didn't like the song at first, but it's grown on me.

cards.note: to put on clothes or shoes to see if they fit or look good
to do something slowly and carefully without hurrying
cards.tip: your 跟着主语变：I took my time；也常单独说 Take your time. 让对方别急。
cards.example: Take your time — the train doesn't leave for an hour.

cards.note: to get enough use or value from something you paid for
cards.tip: money's 的撇号不能丢；your 跟着主语变：get my money's worth。
cards.example: We stayed until the end to get our money's worth.

cards.note: to keep changing your opinion or decision
cards.tip: 本义是「来来回回地走」；在什么事上犹豫用 on / about。
cards.example: We went back and forth about the holiday for weeks.

cards.note: 英式网购说 basket，美式说 cart。
比较级 more nervous；名词 nerves。
to write the information that is asked for on a form
cards.tip: 英式用 fill in，美式多用 fill out；冠词可以换：fill in the form。
cards.example: Please fill in this form and bring it back on Monday.

cards.note: free delivery 是「包邮」。
to start to have doubts about a decision you have made
cards.tip: thoughts 用复数；对什么犹豫用 about。
cards.example: I'm having second thoughts about the new job.

cards.note: to pay for the things you are buying online or in a shop, or to leave a hotel
cards.tip: 名词写成 checkout：go to the checkout；check sth out 还有「看看、了解一下」的意思。
cards.example: Your basket will be saved until you check out.

cards.note: to change a decision or opinion
cards.tip: your 跟着主语变：she changed her mind；mind 用单数。
cards.example: If you change your mind, the offer is still there.

cards.note: review 是评价，-er 表示人。
to decide something together after discussing it
said when something is too complicated to explain now, or you do not want to explain it

cards.text: point sb in the right direction
cards.zh: 给某人指个方向；点拨一下
cards.note: to give someone a little help or advice so they can find the answer themselves

cards.zh: 来信是想……（邮件开头说明目的）
cards.note: used at the start of an email or letter to say why you are writing
available in a shop and ready to buy
if a product or event sells out, there are none left to buy
cards.tip: 说状态常用 be sold out；某店卖完了某物是 sell out of sth：They've sold out of bread。
cards.example: The concert sold out in ten minutes.

cards.note: 重音在后：/təˈtuː/。
